items.title: Why Is Palantir (PLTR) In Focus After Thiel Turned To AI Power Assets?
items.summary: Peter Thiel, linked to Palantir Technologies (NasdaqGS:PLTR), is steering his hedge fund toward AI related electricity and power infrastructure instead of focusing mainly on chipmakers and software companies. The shift reframes AI growth as a question of energy supply and grid capacity rather than just processing power and data analytics. Investors are weighing how this broader view of AI inputs could influence sentiment around software focused AI stocks such as Palantir. As AI investment...
